headline: Apple Announces Record iPhone Sales in Q4
summary: Apple reported record iPhone sales for Q4, driven by strong demand for iPhone 15 Pro models. Services revenue also exceeded expectations.

headline: NVIDIA Partners with Microsoft on AI Chip Development
summary: NVIDIA and Microsoft announced a strategic partnership to co-develop next-generation AI accelerators for Azure cloud services.

headline: Tesla Giga Texas Ramps Production Ahead of Schedule
summary: Tesla's Gigafactory in Texas has exceeded production targets, enabling faster delivery times for Cybertruck reservations.

headline: Google Cloud Revenue Growth Accelerates to 32% YoY
summary: Alphabet's Google Cloud Platform reported 32% year-over-year revenue growth, outpacing AWS and Azure in enterprise AI adoption.
